name: ChannelSale – Sell & Grow Across Marketplaces, Sales Channels & AI Commerce
author: ChannelSale

sections.description:
ChannelSale – Multi-Marketplace Growth Platform for WooCommerce

Sell & Grow Everywhere from One Platform.

Manage, Automate & Grow Across Marketplaces, Sales Channels, AI Commerce & Advertising.

ChannelSale connects your WooCommerce store with Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Wayfair, Etsy, Google Shopping, Meta, TikTok Shop, Newegg, Best Buy, Mercado Libre, Temu and 200+ marketplaces and sales channels from one centralized platform.

Create, optimize and distribute product data across channels to improve product discovery, search visibility, conversion rates and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) across search, advertising and social.

Synchronize product listings, inventory, pricing and orders, automate marketplace operations and deliver consistent, accurate and optimized shopping experiences across marketplaces, storefronts and emerging AI-powered commerce experiences.

Grow Your Commerce Across Every Channel

Expand your WooCommerce business beyond your online store and reach customers wherever they search, discover and shop.

  • 200+ marketplace and sales channel integrations
  • Marketplace and social commerce
  • Search, advertising and product discovery channels
  • Comparison shopping channels
  • Emerging AI Commerce opportunities
  • Centralized multi-channel commerce management

Create & Optimize Product Listings

Dedicated marketplace specialists create and optimize product listings to improve visibility, search performance, conversion rates and sales.

  • Optimized titles, descriptions & attributes
  • Marketplace-specific product data
  • Bulk listing creation and updates
  • Advanced product data rules
  • Category and attribute mapping
  • Support for variations, bundles, kits and parent-child products
  • Marketplace-specific listing optimization

Increase Advertising Performance & ROAS

Optimize product data and marketplace advertising campaigns to improve advertising performance and maximize Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

  • Search and advertising optimization
  • SEM & PPC campaign management
  • Sponsored Ads management
  • Marketplace promotions
  • Product and advertising performance insights
  • Performance monitoring and optimization
  • Marketplace advertising growth strategies

Sync Listings, Inventory, Pricing & Orders

Keep your WooCommerce store and connected sales channels synchronized with automated product, inventory and order management.

  • Near real-time inventory synchronization
  • Product and listing synchronization
  • Automated order synchronization
  • Pricing synchronization
  • Shipment and tracking updates
  • Multi-warehouse and fulfillment support
  • Multi-currency capabilities

Automate & Scale Marketplace Operations

Reduce manual work, minimize operational costs and scale your multi-channel business with centralized marketplace automation.

  • Automated inventory and order management
  • Marketplace-specific pricing rules
  • Automated repricing
  • Inventory buffers
  • Shipping and fulfillment integrations
  • Advanced business rules
  • Centralized marketplace management

Deliver Superior Shopping Experiences

Give customers consistent, accurate and optimized product information wherever they discover, compare and shop for your products.

ChannelSale helps merchants deliver superior shopping experiences across search, advertising, social, marketplaces and storefronts, helping improve visibility, engagement and conversion while supporting stronger performance metrics such as ROAS.

AI Commerce Ready

Prepare your product data and commerce operations for the rapidly evolving world of AI-powered shopping and agentic commerce.

ChannelSale helps merchants maintain structured, accurate and optimized product information across multiple commerce destinations, creating a stronger foundation for product discovery, recommendations and shopping experiences powered by emerging AI technologies.

Strategy Meets Execution

Go beyond marketplace software with dedicated marketplace expertise, hands-on marketing and growth execution.

ChannelSale specialists can support:

  • Buy Box Optimization
  • A+ Content & Rich Media / Enhanced Content Strategy
  • Copywriting & Design
  • PPC & Sponsored Ads
  • Marketplace Promotions
  • Automated Repricing
  • Marketplace Review Syndication
  • Performance Monitoring & Optimization
  • Ongoing Marketplace Growth Optimization

Strategy. Optimize. Execute. Grow.

Reports That Drive Decisions

Turn marketplace, product and advertising data into actionable insights.

  • Sales & performance reports
  • Advertising performance
  • Product & listing performance
  • Pricing & Buy Box insights
  • Marketplace growth analysis

Supported Integrations

Amazon ★ eBay ★ Walmart ★ Google Shopping ★ Facebook ★ Instagram ★ TikTok ★ Etsy ★ Wayfair ★ Bed Bath & Beyond ★ Best Buy ★ Newegg ★ Temu ★ Wish.com ★ Sears ★ Mercado Libre ★ Fruugo ★ OnBuy ★ Shopping.com ★ PriceGrabber ★ and 200+ additional marketplace and sales channel integrations.

Key Features

  • Multi-marketplace product listing management
  • Product, inventory, pricing and order synchronization
  • Near real-time inventory updates
  • Automated marketplace order management
  • Marketplace-specific pricing and repricing
  • Advanced product data optimization rules
  • Multi-warehouse and multi-currency support
  • Shipping, fulfillment and accounting integrations
  • Marketplace, product and advertising performance reporting

Why Businesses Choose ChannelSale

  • Trusted by online sellers since 2007
  • 200+ marketplace and sales channel integrations
  • Dedicated marketplace growth specialists
  • Free managed setup and onboarding
  • No setup fees for supported integrations and no sales commissions
  • Flexible month-to-month pricing
  • Full ownership of your business data

Account Setup and Pricing

A ChannelSale account is required to activate the plugin. Our specialists will guide you through account creation, setup and onboarding.

  • Free Plan – Inventory & Order Sync for up to 500 marketplace products and 15 orders per month, including managed setup and onboarding.
  • Free Trial – Includes everything in the Free Plan, plus sample product listings created and published on your choice of Amazon, eBay or Walmart.
  • Paid Plans – Flexible plans starting from $19/month, designed to scale with your business.
  • No long-term contracts – flexible month-to-month subscriptions.
  • Flat-fee pricing with zero commission on your sales.
  • View all plans and pricing on ChannelSale.
sections.installation:
Getting started is quick and easy.

  1. Email support@channelsale.com to start your Free Plan.
  2. Our specialists will review your requirements to ensure ChannelSale is the right fit for your business.
  3. Once confirmed, we’ll send you an account activation link and guide you through the complete setup process at no cost.

Plugin Installation

  • Install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins page by selecting Add New and uploading the ChannelSale ZIP file, or
  • Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  • Activate the ChannelSale plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.

A ChannelSale account is required to activate the plugin. Our team is available to assist with installation, onboarding and configuration.

Website: www.channelsale.com
sections.faq:
Does the plugin support creating product listings on Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Wayfair and other marketplaces?

Yes. ChannelSale creates new product listings, updates existing listings and supports both simple and variation products across supported marketplaces.

Does the plugin synchronize orders and shipment tracking with WooCommerce?

Yes. ChannelSale automatically imports orders from connected marketplaces into WooCommerce and synchronizes shipment tracking updates back to marketplaces after fulfillment.

Which marketplaces and sales channels are supported?

ChannelSale integrates with Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Google Shopping, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok Shop, Etsy, Wayfair, Best Buy, Newegg, Bed Bath & Beyond, Temu, Mercado Libre, Fruugo, OnBuy, Shopping.com, PriceGrabber and 200+ additional marketplaces and sales channels.

Is a live demo available?

Yes. Contact info@channelsale.com to schedule a personalized live demonstration with one of our marketplace specialists.

What does the FREE Plan include?

The FREE Plan includes Inventory and Order Sync for up to 500 marketplace products and 15 orders per month, along with FREE managed setup and onboarding.

What does the FREE Trial include?

The FREE Trial includes everything in the FREE Plan, plus sample product listings created and published on your choice of Amazon, eBay or Walmart, allowing you to experience ChannelSale before upgrading.

Where can I view pricing?

View ChannelSale pricing on the ChannelSale website.

How do I install and activate the plugin?

Installing the plugin is simple. To activate it, you’ll need a ChannelSale account.

Contact info@channelsale.com or visit ChannelSale Support.

Our team will review your requirements, provide FREE managed setup and guide you through account activation and onboarding.

Need additional help?

Please contact info@channelsale.com or visit ChannelSale Support. Our support team is happy to assist.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 4.7 or greater
  • WooCommerce 2.6.0 or greater
  • PHP version 5.2 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

Support

Email: info@channelsale.com

Call Us Toll-Free

US: +1-866-709-9495
UK: +44-800-029-3271

Website: www.channelsale.com

Follow Us

  • Facebook
  • Twitter
